item.title: 15 states still allow corporal punishment in schools; here's where and why
item.description: Psychologists widely agree it harms children, yet no federal law bans it in public schools, leaving states to decide.

item.title: Feeling restless? Start a side quest to add whimsy to your life
item.description: Experts suggest adding an activity with no purpose other than fun to enrich your main life goals. Play experts share tips.

item.title: Congo's Ebola outbreak hits 5,000 cases, outpacing response efforts
item.description: Government figures show 5,021 cases and 2,378 deaths so far, with the outbreak spreading faster than containment measures.

item.title: How India's ban on a film exposing police abuses backfired
item.description: After Indian authorities blocked the biopic of activist Jaswant Singh Khalra, local villagers and activists turned censorship into grassroots momentum.
